findings.reason: the plan orders same-file writers everywhere else (§31 and §28 each say "build after §26 ... which also writes `reckon/serve.py`"), so §38 needs that edge added, or §31's declaration flipped to done if it has already merged.
findings.text: §38 writes `reckon/serve.py` and orders only against §37 (which writes `reckon/ledger.py`), but §31 is still declared implementable (line 236) and its write paths are "`reckon/metadata_index.py`, `reckon/serve.py` and the test file" (line 237), so §38 declares no ordering against the other open section that writes the same file and the two could be dispatched concurrently into it

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited symbol resolves: `reckon/serve.py` `_crew_rows` (line 1015, calling `ledger.load(name, docs.parent, headers_only=True)` at 1029), `reckon/ledger.py` `_file_identity` (1028) and `_run_snapshot` (1036) reached from `_indexed_data`, `docs/ui/shell.jsx` `refreshRuns` (277), `docs/ui/plan.jsx` (618), `docs/ui/crew.jsx` (331), `docs/ui/_shared.jsx` and `tests/test_spa_crew_cards.py`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §38 asserts a measurable zero-stat/zero-byte count with a declared negative control that routes the roster read back through `ledger.load(..., headers_only=True)` and inverts it, and §39 asserts "at most one outstanding request across ten intervals" with a declared control that swaps the helper for `setInterval`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both sections write their logs under the run directory and §38 records its srv-1006 timings in the landing record, none in a session scratchpad or node-local temp path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches the new `docs/ui/_shared.jsx` helper or the new test symbols.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §38's stated root cause matches its evidence (the poll reaches `_run_snapshot`, which stats every `runs/*.json` via `_file_identity`, from `_crew_rows`), and each section's mechanism produces its own done-when on the named caller: the aggregate-stat members memo for §38 and the settle-then-reschedule helper for §39.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §38 carries one deliverable (the roster read costs one stat of the aggregate) and §39 one goal (a poller never holds two outstanding requests, with the shell and crew view on one `/crew` poll), each proven by its own gate.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §38 declares `depends-on s37` for its `reckon/ledger.py` ordering but omits §31, which the plan still declares implementable and which also writes `reckon/serve.py`.
